criteria.archive: newsletters, digests, notifications, marketing, unsubscribe — no action needed
criteria.reply_now: urgent, requires my response or decision now, refunds, deadlines, approvals
criteria.delegate: forward to a teammate or team, fyi, in the loop, not mine to handle
criteria.mark_todo: an action item for me to do later, follow up, please remember

criteria.relevant: a real job posting that fits my skills and is worth tailoring an application for
criteria.irrelevant: a real job but not a fit for my skills, seniority, or location
criteria.spam: recruiter mass mail, scam, or not a genuine job posting

criteria.blocking: a bug, security issue, or correctness problem that must be fixed before merge
criteria.suggestion: an improvement or style issue worth considering, not required
criteria.nit: a trivial cosmetic, naming, or formatting nitpick

criteria.medical_info: 询问药品用法、剂量、相互作用、疗效等医学问题，需医学部答复
criteria.adverse_event: 报告药品不良反应、副作用或安全隐患，需升级药物警戒
criteria.sales_lead: 潜在客户或医生咨询价格、采购、商务条款等商业机会
criteria.customer_service: 物流、配送、发票、账户等一般客服问题
